Package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.characters

package it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.characters
Contains the tribe character cards that players can collect during a match.

These classes represent the individual character roles present in the tribe deck and expose the static attributes or immediate effects attached to each role.
